title: Master of Spelljugglers
problem: Compares with the last spell cast by *anyone*, not by that creature.
notes: Fix: H | Batch S: left needs-hook. Needs a per-creature last-spell history (the game keeps only the battle-wide last_spell1-3) plus replicating the trait's comparisons; no safe call-site stand-in. User 2026-10-26: 'last one cast' = the last spell cast by anyone (battle-wide, which the game tracks in last_spell1). The only bug is the same as SU-0013 (the slot already holds the current cast); SU-0013's on-cast swap covers bc_OnCast (called directly by bc_EventOnCast), so this is fixed by SU-0013 (needs SU-0123 on). In-game test: all-Spelljuggler party, alternate spell classes: each class change triggers, a same-class repeat doesn't.

release_notes.intended: Triggers when a spell is of a different class than the last spell cast by anyone.
release_notes.actual: The game compared against the wrong spell (the same fault as SU-0013), so the trigger stopped working after a few spells.
release_notes.fix: Now fixed together with SU-0013; requires SU-0013 and SU-0123 to be on.
